research_question: Can a simpler domain-separated structured-output contract improve the local 4B model's observable action trace without changing the successful V39 ontology compiler or sacrificing action safety?

project_scope.system_component: user utterance to observable action frames before deterministic VRM call proposal
project_scope.expected_project_effect: A more reliable boundary between language understanding and future VRM function calls, using a contract the local model can actually follow.

scientific_basis.name: value_agnostic_conversational_semantic_parsing
scientific_basis.design_use: Separate reusable schema structure from values expressed in the utterance.

scientific_basis.name: symbolic_planning_and_code_generation_for_grounded_dialogue
scientific_basis.design_use: Keep language interpretation observable before deterministic grounded execution.

scientific_basis.name: picard_constrained_decoding
scientific_basis.design_use: Reject structurally invalid intermediate outputs instead of treating parseability as semantic validity.

scientific_basis.name: ollama_structured_outputs
scientific_basis.design_use: Request a basic JSON Schema through the local inference API.

infrastructure_boundary.probe_data_relation: unrelated animal example; no project evaluation item was used
infrastructure_boundary.observed_failure: The model emitted animal instead of the schema-required kind field.
infrastructure_boundary.decision: Do not use oneOf, const branches, or conditional schema composition in V40. Use only object, properties, arrays, enums, required fields, and additionalProperties=false.

causal_scope.single_changed_factor: model output contract and its matching instructions

representation.implicit_domain_rule: The containing array supplies the domain for supported frames, so the model cannot pair an expression domain with a motion value.
representation.unsupported_rule: Unsupported frames have an explicit natural domain but normalize deterministically to value=unsupported.
representation.generic_discussion_rule: If an utterance discusses expressions, motion, or gaze without naming a concrete value, the corresponding array remains empty.
representation.final_commitment_rule: For one domain-value target, output only the final commitment after resolving negation, correction, cancellation, and ambiguity across the utterance.
representation.evidence_rule: Every frame must contain one non-empty exact continuous substring copied from user_input.
representation.execution_rule: The parser normalizes valid rows to the unchanged V39 frame interface; only the unchanged V39 grounded compiler may propose allowlisted calls. No proposal is physically executed.

conditions.v39_replay_control: Historical one-array contract using the same model, development cases, one-pass deterministic generation, ontology, and compiler.
conditions.v40_domain_separated_candidate: Four fixed domain arrays using the same model and unchanged V39 ontology compiler.

decision_rule: The candidate must pass every development gate before a fresh holdout can be created. Passing every fresh holdout gate authorizes only shadow integration; physical VRM execution remains disabled.
